description: LeaseExtender (consumer/lease_extender.ex:75-93) only logs lease_not_found, lease_mismatch, or expiry failures and continues looping with the old lease. It never signals Manager/Worker to stop execution, unlike QuiCK's worker flow. Worker.execute/2 also has no lease validation before invoking perform/2. After expiry/reacquisition, the old worker can continue external side effects concurrently with the new owner even though Store.complete/requeue will reject the old lease ID. Add explicit lease-loss signaling, pre-execution validation, and cancellation of the actual perform task; distinguish transient renewal failures before expiry from confirmed lost ownership. Review whether expired-but-unclaimed renewal should be supported (QuiCK permits it; Store.extend_lease currently rejects before reading storage).
title: Stop job execution after losing its item lease
